criteria.label: Ишларни бажариш ва хизматларни кўрсатиш шартлари: Техник топшириқда назарда тутилган хажм, техник параметрлар ва талабларига мувофиқлиги

subject_uz: Olmazor GARDEN issiqxonasidagi quyosh panelining dasturiy ta'minotini ta'mirlash va qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati

requirements.summary_en: Work must be completed in 20 days.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma qiymatining 30 foizi avans sifatida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 30 percent of the contract value is paid as an advance.
requirements.quote: шартнома қийматининг 30% миқдорида бўнак (аванс) маблағи бажарувчи

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi doimiy muhandis-texnik xodimlarga (bosh muhandis, bosh arxitektor va boshqalar) ega bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have permanent engineering staff (chief engineer, chief architect and others).
requirements.quote: доимий ходимлари, жумладан мухандис-техник ходимларига (лойиҳа бош мухандиси, лойиҳа бош архитектори ва бошқа мутахассисларга)

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchining o'z aylanma mablag'i bilan ta'minlanganlik koeffitsiyenti kamida 0,2 bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder's own working-capital ratio must be at least 0.2.
requirements.quote: ўз айланма маблағи билан таъминланганлиги (кўрсаткич 0,2 коэффициентдан кам бўлмаган)

requirements.summary_uz: To'lovga qodirlik koeffitsiyenti kamida 1,25 bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The solvency ratio must be at least 1.25.

requirements.summary_uz: Boshlang'ich narxning 20 foizi miqdorida aylanma mablag' borligi bank ma'lumotnomasi bilan tasdiqlanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Working capital of 20 percent of the start price must be confirmed by a bank certificate.
requirements.quote: Объектнинг буюртмачи белгилаган бошланғич нархининг 20 % миқдоридаги айланма маблағлар мавжудлиги

requirements.summary_uz: Tanlov ob'ektiga o'xshash ob'ektlarda ish tajribasi bo'lishi kerak (oxirgi 3 yil).
requirements.summary_en: Experience on similar objects (last 3 years) is required.
requirements.quote: танлов объектига ўхшаш объектларда ишлаганлик тажрибаси мавжудлиги;

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchida soliq qarzi bo'lmasligi va insofsiz ijrochilar reestrida qayd etilmagan bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: No tax debt and no entry in the register of unfair suppliers.
requirements.quote: Инсофсиз ижрочиларнинг ягона реестрида қайд этилмаганлиги.

The platform form shows 0 percent technical weight, so the mismatch between the two should also be clarified.

reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (page 35): Points are given for a chief architect, architecture and construction specialists and a chief engineer, although the work is repair of solar-panel software. The tender document appears to come from a design-estimate template, so a capable software company could lose points or be rejected. The platform form shows 0 percent technical weight, so the mismatch between the two should also be clarified.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (page 35): The document gives up to 20 points for premises of 36-72 sq m or more and at least 10 units of equipment (including a plotter). A small team that repairs software remotely may not need this and would lose points.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (page 35): For a lot with a start price of 19 million UZS, points are given for fixed assets of at least 100 million UZS and a prior-year profit of 20 million UZS. These are well above the lot value and may cost young or small companies points.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (page 38): The technical task is not about solar-panel software but about current-repair design-estimate documents, state expertise and road indicators. A bidder cannot tell exactly what must be delivered or priced, which may discourage capable companies from bidding.
Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (page 18): The licence is not named. Software repair and support may not need a separate licence, so one clarifying question is worthwhile.

documents_needed_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi, ustav va litsenziya nusxalari
Soliq qarzi yo'qligi haqida DSI ma'lumotnomasi
QQS to'lovchisi sifatida ro'yxatdan o'tganligi haqida DSI ma'lumotnomasi
Oxirgi 3 yillik balans va moliyaviy natijalar hisoboti
Aylanma mablag' mavjudligi haqida bank ma'lumotnomasi
Xodimlarning diplom nusxalari, ishga qabul qilish buyruqlari va mehnat daftarchalari
Ishchi xodimlar soni va ish haqi fondi bo'yicha hisobot nusxalari
O'xshash ob'ektlarda oxirgi 3 yillik tajriba (5-shakl) va bajarilgan ishlar dalolatnomalari
Xonalar va moddiy-texnik vositalar ro'yxati (6-shakl), ijara shartnomasi yoki kadastr hujjati
Bank kafolati yoki buyurtmani ta'minlash to'lovi (1-shakl)
Ishlarni bajarish va moliyalashtirish grafigi, ish hajmlari ro'yxati (1-4 ilovalar)
